about: **Sanggeon Yun** is a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at the University of California, Irvine, where he conducts research in the Bio-Inspired Architecture and Systems Laboratory (BiasLab) under the guidance of **Professor Mohsen Imani**.

His research focuses on developing **efficient and robust machine-learning systems**, spanning robust machine learning, quantum machine learning, hyperdimensional computing, neuro-symbolic AI, and edge computing. He aims to address fundamental limitations of neural network-based models, including limited transparency and commonsense reasoning, susceptibility to hardware noise, and excessive power consumption. His work has appeared in leading venues including NeurIPS, TMLR, CVPR, WACV, ICASSP, ICCAD, DATE, and ISLPED.
Outside his research, he occasionally enjoys competitive programming, solving problems using algorithms and data structures.
